subject: Renewal & expansion pricing — volume step-ups / blended rates
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: J. Smith <j.smith@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-06-10T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal & expansion pricing — volume step-ups / blended rates

Hi John,

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and agreed next steps so we have alignment: 

- Current state: Acme run-rate ~12M tokens/month for chat model usage (customer support routing).
- Expansion ask: planning to add new clinical-summary route + embeddings for search; internal forecast shows 50-75M tokens/month over the next 12 months.
- Key constraints: procurement needs target unit economics and a predictable blended $/1M tokens figure to present to finance.

Open questions / asks from our side:
1) Can you confirm a budget range you are comfortable with for committed spend (e.g., $/1M tokens target)?
2) Which routes/models are highest priority to add first (chat vs embeddings vs reranking)?
3) Any procurement lead we should loop in now so the SOW process goes smoothly?

Next steps: I will draft a preliminary tiered step-up pricing proposal (blended-rate examples included) and share a lightweight pricing model file for you to review. If you can reply with budget range and priority routes by EOD Friday that will help lock the recommendation.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Attachment: (will send pricing model csv)

From: J. Smith <j.smith@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-06-11T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & expansion pricing — volume step-ups / blended rates

Marissa,

Thanks for the recap — that matches our notes. A few clarifications:

- Target unit economics: Finance is looking for a baseline target in the range of $800-$1,100 per 1M tokens for blended usage; they understand top-shelf models will be higher but want overall blended guidance.
- Priority routes: clinical summaries first (chat), then embeddings for search.
- Committed vs burst: we prefer a committed baseline with the option to burst to higher capacity at a slightly higher rate.

I'm attaching our Q3 usage projection (acme_usage_q3.csv). Looping in procurement to start the procurement checklist.

John
J. Smith
Director of Product, Acme Health
j.smith@acmehealth.com
Attachment: acme_usage_q3.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: J. Smith <j.smith@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-15T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal & expansion pricing — volume step-ups / blended rates

John — thanks for the details and the projection. Attached is a preliminary proposal and a lightweight pricing model that shows how blended rates change with different step-up commitments. Highlights below: 

Proposed tiered step-ups (example):
- 0 - 10M tokens / mo: $1,200 per 1M tokens
- 10M - 50M tokens / mo: $950 per 1M tokens
- 50M - 150M tokens / mo: $750 per 1M tokens

Example blended economics: a 40M token committed baseline (mixed routes) results in an approximate blended rate of ~$920 per 1M tokens under this tiering. This assumes chat usage weighted ~70% and embeddings ~30%; we can adjust weights if your usage mix differs.

Committed baseline + burst: We can structure the deal with a committed baseline at the blended price above and a burst rate ~1.25x of the committed blended rate.

Attachments: ACME_Renewal_Proposal_v1.xlsx (proposal + term sheet), ACME_pricing_model.csv (editable model you can use to change mix/volumes).

Next steps:
- Please confirm if the tiering aligns with finance (budget range) and confirm which routes to include in the initial deal.
- If aligned, we will spin a Draft SOW + DocuSign for signature; Michael will help finalize legal/ops items.

Thanks — putting Michael and Laura on thread to help with ops and CS onboarding timing.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: J. Smith <j.smith@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-28T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal & expansion pricing — volume step-ups / blended rates

Marissa, Michael — apologies for the longer review cycle. Finance has reviewed the proposal and we can commit to a 12-month baseline with the following adjustments:

- Agreed initial committed baseline: 45M tokens/mo (mix: 65% chat/35% embeddings).
- Requested blended rate target: lock at $880 per 1M tokens for the committed baseline if we sign within July.
- Burst terms: up to 2x baseline at a 1.3x rate; overage reconciled monthly.

If Redwood can accept a $880 blended commit for 45M tokens with the burst terms above, procurement will route the DocuSign immediately. Please send the final SOW with the locked blended rate and I will confirm start date (targeting 2026-08-01).

John
J. Smith
Director of Product, Acme Health

Note: Procurement contact will prepare standard PO once DocuSign is complete."
